q: What is the process of taking food by an organism called?
e: Process of taking food by an organism called is Nutrition. Nutrition is the idea that completes this fact. Digestion is a different claim from Nutrition.

q: What are the two types of nutrition?
e: The two types of nutrition are autotrophic and Heterotrophic. Heterotrophs must take in food made by other organisms. Aerobic and Anaerobic is a different claim from Autotrophic and Heterotrophic.

q: Which of the following is a characteristic of autotrophic nutrition?
a: Organisms depend on others for food
Organisms can produce their own food
e: Organisms can produce their own food is a characteristic of autotrophic nutrition. Organisms can produce their own food is the idea that completes this fact. Organisms depend on others for food is not a characteristic of autotrophic nutrition.

q: What is the role of chlorophyll in plants?

q: What is the main function of the digestive system in humans?

q: Which of the following is a type of heterotrophic nutrition?

q: What is the process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy?

q: Which of the following is NOT a function of the digestive system?
